title: Bound charged rank-six P104 split support (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact #7277 native word, both charged rank-six productive split partitions are exhausted. The 3+4 partition covers 83 signatures and 714 representative cut incidences. The 2+5 partition covers 83 signatures and 346 incidences. Every enlarged helper cohort has zero pure prefix at the checked cuts. The independent reverse-first replay finds 24 nonzero suffix incidences for 3+4 and zero for 2+5. Both partitions have zero unresolved in scope.

Each alternative adds one paid rank-one endpoint child and replaces one rank-six productive job by ranks 3+4 or 2+5 in each of 17 native copies. The directed price-only lower margins at the old crossing upper are about 0.1174506515937458 and 0.08102479309361352 raw units. The complete compatible saving after exact support is zero.

## Task and overlap

Refines the charged endpoint family at canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact #7277 `ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea` is still the independently reproduced comparator at κ = 0.003645669928698. #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` supplies the signed caller. #7142 gives a higher-rank charged extension on an older word. #7303 holds rank mass fixed. This package covers the two priced rank-six partitions under the retained chart and ownership chronology. The branch carries the two exact #7257 hosted prerequisites.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-charged-rank-six-support-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-charged-rank-six-support-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

Registered, committed-byte/mode/source-history, six navigation tests, and Git-free export passed. Both engines regenerate the complete signed price and exact cut evidence, with ten full plaintext receipt hashes. The standalone replay can emit those receipts with `--out fresh-receipts`. A known-good cocharted basis fixture passes, and wrong pairing, omitted MOVE and modified price controls reject. No changed native, caller or outer verifier ran because neither partition yielded a literal candidate.

## Credit

#7277 and #7113 supply the native word, invoice and signed caller. #7142 supplies charged endpoint funding, #5599 and #7130 supply cocharted split and basis methods, #7299 supplies related pricing, and #7308 supplies the retained invoice audit. Round 37 supplies the typed price census and Round 38 supplies the independent higher-rank replay shape. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Pin a changed chronology or endpoint mechanism, bound its full compatible stock, and require exact prefix and suffix support before building. Smaller ranks and changed charts remain outside this result.
